meta.mission: MORADI REAL-CONTENT TEST — VQ 1.1 method on 10 Kuula posts from ONE house
meta.owner_instruction: kuula.co/profile/Mojtaba87 — 10 related posts from one house so predictions can be precise (VQ1.1 method replaces the previous 10-page test set)
meta.locked_before: any pipeline run / SPZ generation / render measurement
meta.analyst_predictions_rule: written from VLM FACTS (moradi_survey.json) + established VQ1.1 failure-mode knowledge (cabin baseline). Quantified bands are falsifiable.
meta.battery_state_convention: state dir=D, look=back -> camera moves D, VIEWED region = -D (vq11 exp2 convention)
meta.selected_10_rationale: main1..4 + kit1..2 + bed1a/b + bed2a + bed3a = one apartment, full coverage (sitting, entry, open living x2, open kitchen x2, master bedroom pair, child bedroom, pink bedroom). 3 same-space pairs for cross-validation (main3/main4, kit1/kit2, bed1a/bed1b) — this is what makes guesses precise. c7360 EXCLUDED: different house (different style markers, separate upload batch, washing-machine kitchen). kit3a/b EXCLUDED from the 10: service kitchen with exterior doors at BOTH seams, kept as reserve extreme case. bed2b/bed3b reserves.
meta.pipeline_locked_params: v1.1 winner: sigma = 1.3 x footprint, opacity 1.0, stride 2, grid 1022x518, CAM_H 1.5m, depth clip 0.3-60m, SPZ v4 — NO per-scene tuning (method test, not per-image hack)

main1.room_guess: neoclassical sitting room, large (~5x4m), gilt chairs, large rug

pred.worst_state: pz (blown windows behind sheers -> disparity noise at window plane)
pred.special_risk: flowers directly below camera occlude nadir -> small holes in lower band of views that include nadir edge; repetitive identical chairs -> slight depth confusion (minor)

main2.room_guess: entry hall into living, medium (~3x2.5m effective), TWO large wall mirrors AT THE SEAM (u0.01/u0.98 = -x), glazed double doors u0.75, nadir STITCH

pred.worst_state: px — mirror depth collapse: DAV2 reads the REFLECTED room as real geometry at mirror-plane depth -> when the camera translates, reflected content parallax is wrong -> PSNR dip + possible double-edge excess on mirror frame
pred.special_risk: nadir stitch seam -> small magenta holes near bottom band; glossy tile reflections -> floor wobble

main3.room_guess: open-plan living/dining, LARGE (~7x5m), min wall 3.0m, gilded mirror u0.84, glass-top table u0.52, glossy tiles + big ornate rug at nadir

pred.special_risk: glossy tiled floor with ornate rug — floor-band depth noise; far surfaces dominate -> good PSNR overall (best of the 10)

main4.room_guess: same open-plan living/dining as main3 (cross-validation pair), LARGE, min wall 2.5m, TWO gold-framed arched mirrors near seam (u0.05/u0.96 = -x), blown window u0.71 behind sheers, 5 doorways

pred.cross_validation_with_main3: same-space pair -> metric correlation: mean PSNR within 1.5 dB of main3 at matched states; similar sharpness retention
pred.worst_state: px (mirrors near seam — same failure family as main2 px but milder: mirrors further from exact seam)
pred.special_risk: large patterned rug at nadir + glossy tiles -> floor band depth noise; dining chair legs thin

kit1.room_guess: open-plan kitchen/dining/living, LARGE, min wall 1.5m, DUPLICATED DINING TABLE AT BOTH EDGES (u0/u1 wrap = -x seam, real-photo stitch artifact), glass display u0.67, glass-door fridge u0.94, blown window u0.75, glossy floor

pred.worst_state: px — strongest falsifiable call of the set: seam-duplicated furniture -> DAV2 builds the table geometry TWICE at slightly different depths; at 0.75m offset the two copies shear apart -> double-edge EXCESS spike + PSNR minimum of the whole set
pred.special_risk: double-edge excess in px state predicted 1.5-3x the set median

kit2.room_guess: same open-plan kitchen/dining zone as kit1 (cross-validation pair), LARGE, min wall 2.0m, blown window + glass door u0.85 (-z leaning -x), glossy tiled floor with reflections, dining table legs

pred.cross_validation_with_kit1: same-space pair -> px-state PSNR within 2 dB of kit1 px (both see seam region); overall profile similar
pred.worst_state: pz (blown window + glass door + glossy floor reflections)
pred.special_risk: glossy floor reflection depth noise (floor band wobble at offset)

bed1a.room_guess: master bedroom A, medium, min wall 1.0m — camera immediately adjacent to/above the LARGE BED (fills lower field, centre/+x); VANITY MIRROR at u0.5 (+x, exact pano centre!); arched murals, neoclassical

pred.worst_state: mx — vanity mirror at pano centre: mirror depth collapse -> reflected-room parallax error; PLUS near bed surface (~1m) -> largest disocclusion shear of the set
pred.special_risk: bed occupies nadir band: bottom-band holes/shear in states whose view includes the bed silhouette; thin vanity + stool + bench legs

bed1b.room_guess: master bedroom B — SAME ROOM as bed1a from second position (cross-validation pair), large, min wall 1.2m, vanity mirror u0.67 (-z leaning +x), arched headboard wallpaper, bench legs

pred.cross_validation_with_bed1a: same-room pair -> per-state profile correlates (PSNR bands overlap >=50%); both worst in the mirror quadrant
pred.special_risk: second view of the same mirror-room: if predictions for BOTH bed1a/bed1b hit, the mirror failure mode is CONFIRMED twice — cross-validated root cause

bed2a.room_guess: child bedroom, medium, sage green wainscoting, cove ceiling, LARGE rug (nadir mostly covered), window u0.4 (+z leaning +x), hallway door u0.66 (-z leaning -x), bed frame in bottom foreground

pred.special_risk: bed frame bottom foreground (same family as bed1a but milder); no mirrors = cleanest bedroom

bed3a.room_guess: pink bedroom, medium, LARGE CURVED WARDROBE close to camera on the right (u~0.75-1.0 -> -z/-x quadrant, min wall 1.5m), round vanity mirror u0.11 (-x near seam), hallway doors at both seams (u0.01/u0.97), dusty pink paneling

pred.worst_state: pz/pz-family — near-field curved surface (1.5m): silhouette edges of a big curved mass shear strongly at 0.75m; predicted stretch band is the widest of the bedrooms
pred.special_risk: curved wardrobe = curved-silhouette disocclusion (new failure family not present in cabin); round mirror near seam adds px stress

house_level_predictions.pipeline_invariants: bleed 0% and holes ~0% at ALL states (sigma x1.3 + opacity 1.0 coverage is content-independent — these are the V1.1 fix anchors); dot peak same order as cabin (<3000)
